value: seeds primed 24 h in 3% KNO3 (-1.35 MPa) germinated faster and more fully than unprimed seeds (means over 4 and 10 C: T50 37.31 d against 44.85 d, MGT 38.11 against 44.36 d, germination index 14.05 against 9.26, germination 99.16% against 95.92%, all significant at p <= 0.05 by SNK); KNO3 did not differ from hydro-priming (T50 38.57 d, GP 99.25%) or PEG 8000 priming (T50 36.76 d, GP 99.50%), so the gain is a priming effect with no nitrate-specific part shown
